newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila waterworks awards delayed to July.
newsitem.headline: Manila waterworks awards delayed to July.

text.p: The awarding of a 25-year concession for the Manila Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS) has been postponed to July at the earliest, Manila Water Company president Filemon Berba said on Friday.

Manila Water Co, a joint venture between conglomerate Ayala Corp, United Utilities, and Bechtel Corp of the United States, is one of two concessionaires who won the contract through a competitive bidding.
The handover of the operation and management of MWSS was originally scheduled on May 7.

"The commencement has been moved to July 1 at the earliest ... and September 30 is the latest possible. They are still doing the closing audit," Berba told reporters during the stockholders of Ayala Corp.
He said the delay would not affect its income projection as the payment of concession's fee, assumption of obligations, as well as billings and collections would start on the day of the award.
